messages:
maya: quick async standup for SablePay renewal escalation — doing the 3-line check (what I did / blockers / today)
maya: did: triaged overnight webhook 502 spikes, replied to customer, opened incident ticket, created support case #CS-1129
maya: blocker: eng needs tenant-level request IDs and a short-lived token to repro in staging — customer hesitant to share creds on call
maya: today: coordinate hotfix timeline and draft renewal comms for 4pm PT call
anita: on it — I already grabbed a sample trace and started a local repro. can you point me to the exact request ids? @maya
anita: found a suspicious 429->retry loop in the client backoff, might be exposing our rate limiter. I have a tentative fix in a branch. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4921
leo: fyi CS asked for SLA confirmation this morning, Jamal pls confirm whether renewal timeline still firm for EOD week?
jamal: timeline still firm, but customer needs confidence this morning. I can push the 4pm call earlier if deploy is before then.
oncall-bot: ALERT: webhook error-rate spike for customer SablePay detected (increase 4.8x) — sample trace id: sable-abc123 — 2026-03-17T02:15:00Z
anita: traced sable-abc123 — root cause looks like missing `X-Retry-Count` header from their SDK causing repeat replays. pushing patch to staging now, running unit tests
anita: small repro curl for trace: `curl -H "X-Request-Id: sable-abc123" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"evt":"ping"}' https://staging.redwood.io/webhook/sablepay`
maya: can we do a hotfix to prod before the renewal call at 4pm PT? customer on the line then
anita: yes, aiming for a staged rollout. PR merged to main -> will trigger canary deploy. watch logs during canary: ```kubectl logs -l app=webhook -n prod | grep sable-abc123```
deploy-bot: rollout triggered for webhook-service (canary 10%) — rollout id: roll-20260317-71
leo: i'll update renewal comms and note the canary schedule. Jamal, i'll send the revised invite (3:45 call if deploy done)
jamal: ack. i'll confirm on the call and reassure SablePay we have a rollback plan
maya: great — blocker now is watch and confirm traces; once canary passes we mark blocker resolved in CS ticket
anita: canary passed after 12 minutes, metrics look stable. promoting to 100% in 20m
oncall-bot: NOTE: error-rate back to baseline for SablePay (post-canary) — correlation id sable-abc123
maya: thanks everyone — i'll update the renewal thread and attach notes for the 4pm call. closing this async check-in unless something else pops up :thumbsup:
jamal: will join the call and share SLA bundle. good work team
leo: ty all, i'll follow up with a short postmortem blurb for the renewal pack
